description: List Albert Heijn's product categories, e.g. 'Groente, aardappelen' or 'Kaas'. Without parent_id returns the top-level categories (the aisles of ah.nl); with a parent_id, its subcategories with their product counts. Categories overlap, so a subcategory can also appear under other parents. Pass a category id as category_id to ah_search_products to search or list products in it.

parent_id.description: Category id whose subcategories to list

name: ah_get_categories
title: Albert Heijn: Product Categories
